verdicts.reason: A does rearrange the banner for the new shape, but it breaks things. The dot grids are stretched into fragments with chopped partial columns. The '&' logo has been shrunk and pulled away from 'BEDDING'. The image strip floats with an odd chevron edge, and the brand block is crammed into the lower-right corner with dead space above it. B is just the original strip shrunk and centred, leaving about 60% of the canvas empty above and below. Its right-hand dot column is cut off at the edge and 'BEDDING' nearly touches the right edge. B keeps the logo lockup intact but is not a resize at all, so A wins narrowly for at least attempting a layout for the new format.
